name: TreeView
description: `TreeView` is a presentational compound component for hierarchical files, folders, and nested resources. Compose its parts in author order to retain control of item content and visuals while TreeView owns tree semantics, expansion, roving focus, and typeahead.

props.name: flat
props.description: Removes indentation and expansion toggles, for a tree that is only one level deep.

props.name: showGuides
props.description: Shows indentation guides without changing the nesting or expansion controls.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Clips long item labels to one line instead of wrapping them.

props.name: children
props.description: Description of the error.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the user dismisses the error, after the item collapses.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the user chooses to retry loading the subtree.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the dialog.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Use `as="a"` with `href` for a native link.

props.name: containIntrinsicSize
props.description: Reserves a size for off-screen items so a long tree can skip rendering them.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the item as the one currently being viewed.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the item starts expanded when it owns its own expansion state.

props.name: expanded
props.description:
Controls whether the item is expanded. Supply it with `onExpandedChange` to own the state. `null` keeps the item
collapsed and leaves its expanded state unannounced.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the item a link to the given URL.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable identity for the item, used to track focus and expansion.

props.name: leadingAction
props.description: Action shown before the toggle, such as a drag handle. Accepts a callback to vary it with the expanded state.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Visual shown before the label. Accepts a callback to vary it with the item's expanded state.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the item is expanded or collapsed.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when the item is activated by click or keyboard.

props.name: secondaryActions
props.description:
Actions shown at the end of the row for pointer users. Keyboard users reach them with Shift+Meta+U on Apple
platforms or Shift+Control+U elsewhere: one action runs directly, several open a dialog to choose from.

props.name: subtree
props.description: Nested items, as an alternative to supplying a subtree child. Takes precedence over a `TreeView.SubTree` child.

props.name: to
props.description: Route the item links to, for integration with a router.

props.name: trailingVisual
props.description: Visual shown after the label. Accepts a callback to vary it with the item's expanded state.

props.name: children
props.description: The action, such as a drag handle button. Accepts a callback to vary it with the item's expanded state.

props.name: label
props.description: Text describing the action. Like the action itself, it is hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the visual, which is announced as part of the item's description.

props.name: flat
props.description: Removes indentation and expansion toggles, for a tree that is only one level deep.

props.name: showGuides
props.description: Shows indentation guides without changing the nesting or expansion controls.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Clips long item labels to one line instead of wrapping them.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of placeholder rows to show while the subtree loads. Without it, a spinner row is shown.

props.name: state
props.description:
Loading state of the subtree. `loading` shows placeholders and announces the load; moving from `loading` to
`done` announces the result and moves focus from a focused placeholder to the first loaded item.
